name: Monash Equity, Diversity and Inclusion Scholarship
summary: A graduate research stipend for domestic students whose academic career has been affected by equity factors.
key: $41,100 a year (2027 rate), up to 20 offered each year.
who: Australian or NZ citizen, permanent resident or humanitarian visa holder.
Holds an Australian or NZ bachelor's degree with second class honours.
Academic career adversely affected due to equity grounds.
how: Apply with your graduate research course application and upload the supplementary form in myApp.
catches: Domestic rounds close 31 May and 31 October each year.
